name: dumbbells sumo squat
description: A wide stance squat holding dumbbells that emphasises the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes pointing out.
Hold one or two dumbbells with both hands in front of you.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to stand.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
